item.title: Russia fired over 2,800 drones at Ukraine in August amid war tactic change
item.description: Over the course of the month of August, Russia launched more than 2,800 jet-propelled drones at Ukraine, a type of drone that is harder to shoot down. That has come with a massive uptick in the number of drones used, considerind those now found on the frontline are quite a new model: Ukrainian authorities say they are pressed into service almost immediately after leaving the factory. FRANCE 24's Oliver Farry looks at those new drones, and how Russia is using them to try and change the course of the war. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Brazil’s humpback whales make stunning comeback; population surges from just 2,000 to nearly 35,000
item.description: Brazil’s humpback whale population has recovered from about 2,000 to nearly 35,000 after commercial whaling pushed the species close to extinction.
